470	def dev_speed_limit_sign_kind (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option SpeedSignKind := (s.device d).bind (·.speedKind)
471	def dev_regulatory_sign (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Bool := devKind s d .regulatorySign
472	def dev_regulatory_sign_code (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option SignCode := (s.device d).bind (·.code)
473	def dev_regulatory_sign_conditions (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Conditions := (s.device d).bind (·.conditions)

475	def dev_zone_sign_kind (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option ZoneKind := (s.device d).bind (·.zoneKind)
476	def dev_zone_sign_end (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Bool := (s.device d).bind (·.isEnd)
477	def dev_zone_sign_conditions (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Conditions := (s.device d).bind (·.conditions)
478	def dev_railway_signal_or_gate (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Bool := devKind s d .railwaySignalOrGate
479	def dev_railway_signal_or_gate_lights (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option RailLights := (s.device d).bind (·.railLights)
480	def dev_railway_signal_or_gate_gate (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option GateState := (s.device d).bind (·.gate)
481	def dev_railway_signal_or_gate_bell (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Bool := (s.device d).bind (·.bell)

484	def dev_human_direction_role (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option HumanRole := (s.device d).bind (·.humanRole)
485	def dev_human_direction_indication (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option HumanIndication := (s.device d).bind (·.humanIndication)
486	def dev_governs (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) (r : RegionId) : Option Bool :=

488	def dev_governs_regions (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option (List RegionId) :=

490	def dev_position (s : Scene) (d : DeviceId) : Option Vec := (s.device d).bind (·.position)

500	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
501	-- Signals emitted by road users
502	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
503	def sig_turn_indicator (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option TurnIndicatorState := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.turnIndicator)
504	def sig_brake_lamp (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.brakeLamp)
505	def sig_hazard (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.hazard)
506	def sig_headlamp (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option HeadlampState := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.headlamp)
507	def sig_position_lamp (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.positionLamp)

509	/-- A warning lamp of the given colour lit, in any mode or facing. -/
510	def sig_warning_lamp_colour (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (c : LampColour) : Option Bool :=
511	  (sig_warning_lamp s x).map (·.any (·.colour == c))
512	def sig_warning_lamp_shows (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (c : LampColour) (m : LampMode) : Option Bool :=
513	  (sig_warning_lamp s x).map (·.any fun l => l.colour == c && l.mode == m)
514	def sig_siren (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.siren)
515	def sig_horn (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.horn)
516	def sig_hand_signal (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option HandSignal := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.handSignal)
517	def sig_door_open (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option (List DoorSide) := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.doorsOpen)
518	def sig_door_open_side (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (side : DoorSide) : Option Bool := (sig_door_open s x).map (·.contains side)
519	def sig_compression_brake (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.user x).bind (·.sig.compressionBrake)
520	
521	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
522	-- Environment
523	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
524	def env_darkness (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.darkness
525	def env_precipitation (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.precipitation
526	def env_wet_road (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.wetRoad
527	def env_ice_or_snow (s : Scene) : Option Bool := s.env.iceOrSnow
528	def env_visibility (s : Scene) : Option Q := s.env.visibility
529	def env_civil_time (s : Scene) : Option CivilTime := s.env.civilTime
530	
531	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
532	-- Relations between road users. Measured where the source supplies them, otherwise computed
533	-- from kinematics. `none` when a needed kinematic is missing.
534	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
535	def rel_centre_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
536	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.centreDistance) with
537	  | some d => some d
538	  | none => do
539	    let pa ← kin_position s a
540	    let pb ← kin_position s b
541	    pure (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub pb pa))
542	
543	/-- Components of `b`'s position relative to `a` in `a`'s heading frame (longitudinal, lateral). -/
544	private def relFrame (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) := do
545	  let pa ← kin_position s a
546	  let pb ← kin_position s b
547	  let ha ← kin_heading s a
548	  Geom.inFrame ha (Geom.vsub pb pa)
549	
550	/-- The gap between the two bodies: the vector from the nearest point of `a`'s footprint to the
551	    nearest point of `b`'s, each footprint read with its own heading and extent, given as its
552	    lengths along and across `a`'s heading (longitudinal, lateral). Neither is ever negative; both
553	    are zero exactly when the footprints touch or overlap. `none` when either footprint is not
554	    observed, and when a supplied gap has a negative component. -/
555	def rel_surface_gap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) :=
556	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.surfaceGap) with
557	  | some g => if Q.isNonneg g.1 && Q.isNonneg g.2 then some g else none
558	  | none => do
559	    let fa ← footprint s a
560	    let fb ← footprint s b
561	    let d ← Geom.nearestOffset fa fb
562	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
563	    let (lon, lat) ← Geom.inFrame ha d
564	    pure (Q.abs lon, Q.abs lat)
565	def rel_surface_gap_longitudinal (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.1)
566	def rel_surface_gap_lateral (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map (·.2)
567	/-- The distance between the nearest points of the two bodies, the gap's length: zero on contact
568	    or overlap, never negative. -/
569	def rel_surface_gap_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map Geom.norm
570	
571	/-- `a` and `b` share a lane and `a` is ahead of `b` along `a`'s heading. The lane is any region both
572	    occupy that is of kind lane (`Structure.isOfKind`): unknown when `a` is ahead and no shared region
573	    is known to be a lane but one may be. -/
574	def rel_ahead_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
575	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.aAheadOfB) with
576	  | some v => some v
577	  | none => do
578	    let ra ← rel_occupies_regions s a
579	    let rb ← rel_occupies_regions s b
580	    let (lon, _) ← relFrame s a b
581	    if !Q.lt lon Q.zero then some false
582	    else
583	      let shared := (s.structures.filter fun st => ra.contains st.id && rb.contains st.id).map (·.isOfKind .lane)
584	      if shared.contains (some true) then some true
585	      else if shared.contains none then none
586	      else some false
587	def rel_ahead_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s a b
588	def rel_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s b a
589	
590	/-- Signed overlap of the two footprints along `a`'s heading, each read with its own heading and
591	    extent: the length their projections on that axis share, positive when the bodies are side by
592	    side, otherwise the gap between the projections negated. A projection: it reads nothing across
593	    the axis, so a positive value is no contact and a negative one no distance between the bodies. -/
594	def rel_longitudinal_overlap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
595	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.longitudinalOverlap) with
596	  | some v => some v
597	  | none => do
598	    let pa ← kin_position s a
599	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
600	    let u ← Geom.unit ha
601	    let fa ← footprint s a
602	    let fb ← footprint s b
603	    let (loA, hiA) ← Geom.span u pa fa
604	    let (loB, hiB) ← Geom.span u pa fb
605	    pure (Q.sub (Q.min hiA hiB) (Q.max loA loB))
606	
607	/-- Headings opposed (cosine below `-cosTol`) and the distance decreasing. -/
608	def rel_oncoming (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
609	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.oncoming) with
610	  | some v => some v
611	  | none => do
612	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
613	    let hb ← kin_heading s b
614	    let pa ← kin_position s a
615	    let pb ← kin_position s b
616	    let va ← kin_velocity s a
617	    let vb ← kin_velocity s b
618	    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
619	    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
620	    let closing := Q.lt (Geom.dot (Geom.vsub pb pa) (Geom.vsub vb va)) Q.zero
621	    pure (Q.lt (Geom.dot ua ub) (Q.neg cosTol) && closing)
622	
623	/-- Headings aligned (cosine above `cosTol`). -/
624	def rel_same_direction (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
625	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.sameDirection) with
626	  | some v => some v
627	  | none => do
628	    let ha ← kin_heading s a
629	    let hb ← kin_heading s b
630	    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
631	    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
632	    pure (Q.gt (Geom.dot ua ub) cosTol)
633	
634	/-- `b` relative to `a` in `a`'s frame: (longitudinal, lateral), lateral positive to the left. -/
635	def rel_bearing (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Vec :=
636	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.bearing) with
637	  | some v => some v
638	  | none => relFrame s a b
639	def rel_bearing_right (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.2 Q.zero
640	def rel_bearing_left (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.2 Q.zero
641	def rel_bearing_ahead (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.1 Q.zero
642	def rel_bearing_behind (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.1 Q.zero
643	
644	/-- The bodies touch or overlap. -/
645	def rel_contact (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
646	  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.contact) with
647	  | some v => some v
648	  | none => (rel_surface_gap s a b).map fun g => Q.le g.1 Q.zero && Q.le g.2 Q.zero
649	
650	/-- `b` is in `a`'s line of sight, as the source tested it; never computed. -/
651	def rel_visible (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.relation a b).bind (·.visible)
652	
653	end TrafficSpec

/-
  TRAINING SPLIT of TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms. Generated from Core/Vocab/Atoms.lean by
  ontology_provenance/nrs_tools/atoms_train.py: the definitions of the atoms whose only textual
  support is a test line are omitted. Do not edit; regenerate.
-/
/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms
  The bijection with the atoms of ATOMS.md: exactly one definition per atom id, named `family_name`,
  each reading one field of `World` and nothing else. Attribute accessors of an atom carry the
  atom's name plus a suffix (`dev_traffic_signal_shows`, `ru_rider_posture_on_seat`).

  Rules of this file, held by the doctor:
  - every `\`family.name\`` in ATOMS.md has exactly one `def family_name` here and vice versa;
  - no thresholds, no comparisons against constants, no temporal lookback: a threshold is a rule's
    or a derived concept's business;
  - the `rel_*` atoms may compute geometry from kinematics, because their contract says they are
    "computed from kinematics; listed because a source may supply them measured" — a measured
    value, when the source gives one, is preferred; `rel_visible` reads a measured value only.

  Every atom is three-valued: `none` is "not observed on this source".
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.World
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Assumptions

namespace TrafficSpec

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Geometry helpers for the `rel_*` atoms (exact rationals; the one square root is an integer
-- square root at micrometre resolution).
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
namespace Geom
def vsub (a b : Vec) : Vec := (Q.sub a.1 b.1, Q.sub a.2 b.2)
def vadd (a b : Vec) : Vec := (Q.add a.1 b.1, Q.add a.2 b.2)
def dot (a b : Vec) : Q := Q.add (Q.mul a.1 b.1) (Q.mul a.2 b.2)
/-- 2-D cross product `a × b`; positive when `b` is to the left of `a`. -/
def cross (a b : Vec) : Q := Q.sub (Q.mul a.1 b.2) (Q.mul a.2 b.1)
def normSq (a : Vec) : Q := dot a a
/-- Square root of a non-negative quantity in metres, floored to micrometres. -/
def sqrtMicro (q : Q) : Q :=
  if q.num ≤ 0 then Q.zero
  else
    let scaled : Int := (q.num * 1000000000000) / (q.den : Int)   -- µm²
    Units.micrometres (Int.ofNat (isqrt scaled.toNat))
def norm (a : Vec) : Q := sqrtMicro (normSq a)
/-- The unit vector along `a`; `none` for the zero vector only. `a` is first divided by its larger
    absolute component, so the vector normalised has length between 1 and √2 whatever `a`'s scale,
    and then by that length taken to micrometres (`norm`). The result is the exact unit vector times
    a factor of at least 1 and below 1 + 2·10⁻⁶, and is exact where the scaled length is a whole
    number of micrometres (every axis-aligned direction). -/
def unit (a : Vec) : Option Vec :=
  let m := Q.max (Q.abs a.1) (Q.abs a.2)
  if Q.isZero m then none
  else
    let b := (Q.div a.1 m, Q.div a.2 m)
    let n := norm b
    some (Q.div b.1 n, Q.div b.2 n)
/-- Components of `v` in the frame of heading `h` (longitudinal, lateral); lateral positive = left.
    `h` is read as a direction (`unit`), whatever its length; `v` keeps its own. -/
def inFrame (h v : Vec) : Option (Q × Q) := do
  let u ← unit h
  pure (dot u v, cross u v)
/-- Distance from a point to a segment. -/
def segmentDistance (p a b : Vec) : Q :=
  let ab := vsub b a
  let ap := vsub p a
  let l2 := normSq ab
  if Q.isZero l2 then norm ap
  else
    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot ap ab) l2))
    norm (vsub p (vadd a (Q.mul t ab.1, Q.mul t ab.2)))
/-- Whether a point lies inside a polygon (ray casting), for footprint-in-region tests. -/
def inPolygon (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  let n := poly.length
  if n < 3 then false
  else
    let edges := (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
    let crossings := edges.filter fun (a, b) =>
      let (ax, ay) := a; let (bx, by_) := b
      ((Q.le ay p.2) != (Q.le by_ p.2)) &&
        -- x-intersection of the edge with the horizontal line through p, compared with p.x
        (let dy := Q.sub by_ ay
         !Q.isZero dy &&
         Q.lt p.1 (Q.add ax (Q.div (Q.mul (Q.sub p.2 ay) (Q.sub bx ax)) dy)))
    crossings.length % 2 == 1
/-- The sign of `(b − a) × (c − a)`: 1 when `c` is to the left of `ab`, −1 to its right, 0 on its line. -/
def orient (a b c : Vec) : Int :=
  let k := (cross (vsub b a) (vsub c a)).num
  if k > 0 then 1 else if k < 0 then -1 else 0
/-- Whether `p` lies on the closed segment `ab`, given that it lies on its line. -/
def withinBox (p a b : Vec) : Bool :=
  Q.le (Q.min a.1 b.1) p.1 && Q.le p.1 (Q.max a.1 b.1) && Q.le (Q.min a.2 b.2) p.2 && Q.le p.2 (Q.max a.2 b.2)
/-- Whether the closed segments `ab` and `cd` share a point, touching and collinear overlap included. -/
def segmentsIntersect (a b c d : Vec) : Bool :=
  let o1 := orient a b c; let o2 := orient a b d; let o3 := orient c d a; let o4 := orient c d b
  (o1 * o2 < 0 && o3 * o4 < 0) || (o1 == 0 && withinBox c a b) || (o2 == 0 && withinBox d a b)
    || (o3 == 0 && withinBox a c d) || (o4 == 0 && withinBox b c d)
/-- The edges of a polygon, the last vertex closing to the first. -/
def edges (poly : List Vec) : List (Vec × Vec) :=
  let n := poly.length
  (List.range n).map fun i => (poly[i]!, poly[(i + 1) % n]!)
/-- Whether two polygons share a point as closed sets: an edge of one meets an edge of the other
    (touching counts), or one lies inside the other. Exact. -/
def polygonsOverlap (p q : List Vec) : Bool :=
  (edges p).any (fun (a, b) => (edges q).any fun (c, d) => segmentsIntersect a b c d)
    || p.any (inPolygon · q) || q.any (inPolygon · p)
/-- Distance from a point to a polygon's boundary: zero inside, the nearest edge outside. -/
def polygonDistance (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Q :=
  match poly with
  | [] => none
  | [a] => some (norm (vsub p a))
  | _ =>
    if inPolygon p poly then some Q.zero
    else
      let n := poly.length
      let ds := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentDistance p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
/-- The point of a segment nearest a point. -/
def segmentNearest (p a b : Vec) : Vec :=
  let ab := vsub b a
  let l2 := normSq ab
  if Q.isZero l2 then a
  else
    let t := Q.max Q.zero (Q.min (Q.ofInt 1) (Q.div (dot (vsub p a) ab) l2))
    vadd a (Q.mul t ab.1, Q.mul t ab.2)
/-- The point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point. -/
def nearestPoint (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
  match poly with
  | [] => none
  | [a] => some a
  | _ =>
    let n := poly.length
    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
    cs.foldl (fun acc c => match acc with
      | none => some c
      | some b => if Q.lt (normSq (vsub p c)) (normSq (vsub p b)) then some c else some b) none
/-- Every point of a polygon's boundary nearest a point: the nearest point of each edge whose
    distance is the least, so a tie keeps every equally near point whatever the vertex order. -/
def nearestPoints (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Vec :=
  match poly with
  | [] => []
  | [a] => [a]
  | _ =>
    let n := poly.length
    let cs := (List.range n).map fun i => segmentNearest p poly[i]! poly[(i + 1) % n]!
    match cs.map fun c => normSq (vsub p c) with
    | [] => []
    | d :: ds =>
      let m := ds.foldl Q.min d
      cs.filter fun c => Q.eq (normSq (vsub p c)) m
/-- The vector from the nearest point of polygon `p` to the nearest point of polygon `q`: zero when
    they share a point (`polygonsOverlap`), otherwise the shortest vector joining a vertex of one to
    the nearest point of the other's boundary, which for two convex polygons is the same for every
    nearest pair. `none` for an empty polygon. -/
def nearestOffset (p q : List Vec) : Option Vec :=
  if polygonsOverlap p q then some (Q.zero, Q.zero)
  else
    let fromP := p.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c q).map (vsub · c)
    let fromQ := q.filterMap fun c => (nearestPoint c p).map (vsub c ·)
    (fromP ++ fromQ).foldl (fun acc d => match acc with
      | none => some d
      | some e => if Q.lt (normSq d) (normSq e) then some d else some e) none
/-- The interval a polygon covers along the direction `u`, measured from `o`: (lowest, highest). -/
def span (u o : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Option (Q × Q) :=
  match poly.map fun c => dot u (vsub c o) with
  | [] => none
  | x :: xs => some (xs.foldl Q.min x, xs.foldl Q.max x)
/-- Twice the signed area of a polygon (the shoelace sum). -/
def area2 (poly : List Vec) : Q :=
  (edges poly).foldl (fun acc (a, b) => Q.add acc (cross a b)) Q.zero
/-- Whether a polygon's boundary crosses or touches itself: two edges that are not neighbours
    meet, or two neighbouring edges fold back along one line. -/
def selfIntersects (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  let es := (edges poly).toArray
  let n := es.size
  (List.range n).any fun i => (List.range n).any fun j =>
    if j ≤ i then false
    else
      let (a, b) := es[i]!
      let (c, d) := es[j]!
      if j == i + 1 then orient a b d == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub b a) (vsub d c)) Q.zero
      else if i == 0 && j + 1 == n then orient c d b == 0 && Q.lt (dot (vsub d c) (vsub b a)) Q.zero
      else segmentsIntersect a b c d
/-- A simple polygon: at least three vertices, a non-zero area, and a boundary that neither crosses
    nor touches itself (a repeated vertex makes two edges that are not neighbours meet). -/
def simplePolygon (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  poly.length ≥ 3 && !Q.isZero (area2 poly) && !selfIntersects poly
/-- Whether a point lies on a polygon's boundary. Exact. -/
def onBoundary (p : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
  (edges poly).any fun (a, b) => orient a b p == 0 && withinBox p a b
/-- The parameters `t` at which the line `p + t·u` meets the polygon's boundary: one per edge it
    crosses or touches, and both ends of an edge it runs along. `u` is not the zero vector. -/
def lineCrossings (p u : Vec) (poly : List Vec) : List Q :=
  (edges poly).flatMap fun (a, b) =>
    let d := vsub b a
    let w := vsub a p
    let den := cross u d
    if Q.isZero den then
      if Q.isZero (cross u w) then [Q.div (dot w u) (dot u u), Q.div (dot (vsub b p) u) (dot u u)] else []
    else
      let s := Q.div (cross w u) den
      if Q.le Q.zero s && Q.le s (Q.ofInt 1) then [Q.div (cross w d) den] else []
end Geom

/-- Whether kind `a` refines kind `b`, reflexively and transitively. -/
def StructureKind.refines (a b : StructureKind) : Bool := a == b || a.ancestors.contains b

/-- Whether a source that cannot tell kind `m` (it is among `unobservedKinds`) leaves this structure's
    membership of `m`'s kinds open: always where `m` refines no kind other than an abstract one;
    otherwise only where the structure is labelled `m` or a kind `m` refines, since a structure of any
    other kind is known not to be one. -/
def Structure.maskApplies (st : Structure) (m : StructureKind) : Bool :=
  (m.parent?.filter (!·.isAbstract)).isNone || m.refines st.kind

/-- Whether a structure is of kind `k`: unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
    structure, is `k` or a kind `k` refines (the label cannot be trusted for `k`); true where the
    structure's kind refines `k`; unknown where a kind the source cannot tell, applying to this
    structure, refines `k`; false otherwise. A parent never implies a kind refining it, two kinds
    refining one parent never imply each other, and a kind the source cannot tell never makes a known
    parent unknown. An abstract kind is the union of the kinds refining it: true where the structure
    is of one of them, unknown where it is of none and unknown for one, false otherwise. -/
def Structure.isOfKind (st : Structure) (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
  let masked := st.unobservedKinds.filter st.maskApplies
  let concrete (k : StructureKind) : Option Bool :=
    if masked.any (k.refines ·) then none
    else if st.kind.refines k then some true
    else if masked.any (·.refines k) then none
    else some false
  if k.isAbstract then
    let vs := (StructureKind.all.filter (·.parent? == some k)).map concrete
    if vs.contains (some true) then some true else if vs.contains none then none else some false
  else concrete k

  (s.structure? r).bind (·.isOfKind k)

def st_region_geometry (s : Scene) (r : RegionId) : Option (Option Vec × Option (List Vec)) :=
  (s.structure? r).map fun st => (st.position, st.boundary)

/-- The rectangle a road user's body covers on the ground, from its position, heading and
    half-extents; `none` when one of them is not observed. -/
def footprint (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option (List Vec) := do
  let p ← kin_position s x
  let h ← kin_heading s x
  let (hl, hw, _) ← kin_extent s x
  let u ← Geom.unit h
  let v := (Q.neg u.2, u.1)
  let corner (a b : Q) : Vec := Geom.vadd p (Q.add (Q.mul a u.1) (Q.mul b v.1), Q.add (Q.mul a u.2) (Q.mul b v.2))
  pure [corner hl hw, corner hl (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) (Q.neg hw), corner (Q.neg hl) hw]

/-- Ground distance from a road user's body to a region: zero when the footprint overlaps the
    boundary, otherwise the nearest approach between the two outlines. Without a footprint (no
    extent or heading observed) the reference point is used; a point-like structure is measured
    to its reference point. -/
def st_region_geometry_distance (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (r : RegionId) : Option Q := do
  let p ← kin_position s x
  match st_region_geometry_boundary s r, footprint s x with
  | some poly, some fp =>
    if Geom.polygonsOverlap fp poly then some Q.zero
    else
      let ds := fp.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · poly) ++ poly.filterMap (Geom.polygonDistance · fp)
      ds.foldl (fun acc d => match acc with | none => some d | some a => some (Q.min a d)) none
  | some poly, none => Geom.polygonDistance p poly
  | none, fp =>
    let c ← st_region_geometry_position s r
    match fp with
    | some poly => Geom.polygonDistance c poly
    | none => some (Geom.norm (Geom.vsub c p))
/-- The regions present in the scene known to be of a kind (`Structure.isOfKind` true). -/

/-- The regions a quantifier over a kind ranges over: those whose membership of the kind is not
    false (`Structure.isOfKind`), the known members and those that may be members. -/
def regionCandidates (s : Scene) (k : StructureKind) : List RegionId :=
  (s.structures.filter (·.isOfKind k != some false)).map (·.id)

def rel_centre_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=

private def relFrame (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) := do

  let pb ← kin_position s b
  let ha ← kin_heading s a

    nearest point of `b`'s, each footprint read with its own heading and extent, given as its
    lengths along and across `a`'s heading (longitudinal, lateral). Neither is ever negative; both

    observed, and when a supplied gap has a negative component. -/
def rel_surface_gap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option (Q × Q) :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.surfaceGap) with
  | some g => if Q.isNonneg g.1 && Q.isNonneg g.2 then some g else none
  | none => do
    let fa ← footprint s a
    let fb ← footprint s b
    let d ← Geom.nearestOffset fa fb
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let (lon, lat) ← Geom.inFrame ha d
    pure (Q.abs lon, Q.abs lat)

    or overlap, never negative. -/
def rel_surface_gap_distance (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q := (rel_surface_gap s a b).map Geom.norm

    occupy that is of kind lane (`Structure.isOfKind`): unknown when `a` is ahead and no shared region
    is known to be a lane but one may be. -/
def rel_ahead_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.aAheadOfB) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ra ← rel_occupies_regions s a
    let rb ← rel_occupies_regions s b
    let (lon, _) ← relFrame s a b
    if !Q.lt lon Q.zero then some false
    else
      let shared := (s.structures.filter fun st => ra.contains st.id && rb.contains st.id).map (·.isOfKind .lane)
      if shared.contains (some true) then some true
      else if shared.contains none then none
      else some false
def rel_ahead_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s a b
def rel_behind_in_lane (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := rel_ahead_behind_in_lane s b a

/-- Signed overlap of the two footprints along `a`'s heading, each read with its own heading and
    extent: the length their projections on that axis share, positive when the bodies are side by
    side, otherwise the gap between the projections negated. A projection: it reads nothing across
    the axis, so a positive value is no contact and a negative one no distance between the bodies. -/
def rel_longitudinal_overlap (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Q :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.longitudinalOverlap) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let u ← Geom.unit ha
    let fa ← footprint s a
    let fb ← footprint s b
    let (loA, hiA) ← Geom.span u pa fa
    let (loB, hiB) ← Geom.span u pa fb
    pure (Q.sub (Q.min hiA hiB) (Q.max loA loB))

/-- Headings opposed (cosine below `-cosTol`) and the distance decreasing. -/
def rel_oncoming (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.oncoming) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let hb ← kin_heading s b
    let pa ← kin_position s a
    let pb ← kin_position s b
    let va ← kin_velocity s a
    let vb ← kin_velocity s b
    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
    let closing := Q.lt (Geom.dot (Geom.vsub pb pa) (Geom.vsub vb va)) Q.zero
    pure (Q.lt (Geom.dot ua ub) (Q.neg cosTol) && closing)

/-- Headings aligned (cosine above `cosTol`). -/
def rel_same_direction (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (cosTol : Q) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.sameDirection) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => do
    let ha ← kin_heading s a
    let hb ← kin_heading s b
    let ua ← Geom.unit ha
    let ub ← Geom.unit hb
    pure (Q.gt (Geom.dot ua ub) cosTol)

/-- `b` relative to `a` in `a`'s frame: (longitudinal, lateral), lateral positive to the left. -/
def rel_bearing (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Vec :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.bearing) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => relFrame s a b
def rel_bearing_right (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.2 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_left (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.2 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_ahead (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.gt v.1 Q.zero
def rel_bearing_behind (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (rel_bearing s a b).map fun v => Q.lt v.1 Q.zero

/-- The bodies touch or overlap. -/
def rel_contact (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool :=
  match (s.relation a b).bind (·.contact) with
  | some v => some v
  | none => (rel_surface_gap s a b).map fun g => Q.le g.1 Q.zero && Q.le g.2 Q.zero

/-- `b` is in `a`'s line of sight, as the source tested it; never computed. -/
def rel_visible (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) : Option Bool := (s.relation a b).bind (·.visible)

end TrafficSpec

/-
  Witnesses for NRS_484B_407.

  The geometry, once built. One straight carriageway runs east along y = 0: a highway region
  (`way`, id 10, 1200 m by 60 m) with one or two roadway stretches on it (ids 11 and 12, each 20 m
  wide), and, where a witness needs one, a crest region (id 20, a 4 m band across the carriageway
  with its reference point on the centre line). A stretch carries the two figures the source
  records for it: the magnitude of its horizontal curvature (zero on a tangent, 1/50 m on a bend of
  50 m radius, twenty times the resolution of the reading) and its sight distance (60 m, well short
  of the 500 feet the text states, or 400 m, well beyond them).

  The subject (track 1) is a motor car 5 m long and 2 m wide running at 8 m/s. Every trace is
  sampled at 50 ms, the period of the run's acquisition profile, so the heading change the rule
  accumulates is never read across a wider interval. The subject runs straight until the onset
  observation and from there sweeps left at 60 deg/s, 3 degrees per observation: 150 degrees — the
  reversal angle of the reading — are reached fifty observations after the onset. `permitTrace`
  stops the sweep after ten observations (30 degrees, far below the angle). The body advances
  0.4 m per observation along the carriageway while its heading steps through the exact rational
  unit vectors the source records (east, 4/5-3/5, north, −3/5-4/5, west); no atom the rule reads
  compares the two, and the 20 m the body covers during a sweep is what moves it across a stretch
  boundary or away from the crest.

  Every witness names the instants it speaks about: the rule searches the past from the onset of
  the manoeuvre, so each window begins at the onset observation and ends at the last observation of
  the trace. Every figure here is the witness's own and appears nowhere in the rule.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B.NRS_484B_407
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_407

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n

-- Binders ↦ tracks: v ↦ 1

/-- The sampling period of the trace: one scene every 50 ms. -/
def step : Q := Units.milliseconds 50
/-- A rate of turn, in degrees per second. -/
def degPerSec (n : Int) : Q := Units.degrees n
/-- The horizontal curvature (1/m) of a bend of radius `r` metres. -/
def curvatureOfRadius (r : Int) : Q := Q.div (Units.perMetre 1) (m r)
/-- A tangent: the source records no curvature at all. -/
def tangent : Q := Q.zero
/-- The sight distance of a blind place, and of an open one. -/
def shortSight : Q := m 60
def openSight : Q := m 400

/-- The public way between its boundary lines: every subject below lies on it. -/
def way : Structure := Build.rect 10 .highway (m (-600)) (m (-30)) (m 600) (m 30)

/-- A carriageway stretch from `x0` to `x1`, with the curvature and sight distance the source
    records for it. -/
def stretch (id : RegionId) (x0 x1 curv sight : Q) : Structure :=
  { Build.rect id .roadway x0 (m (-10)) x1 (m 10) with
      curvature := some curv, sightDistance := some sight }

/-- The footway beside the carriageway, part of the way and no roadway. -/
def footway : Structure := Build.rect 13 .sidewalk (m (-200)) (m 15) (m 400) (m 25)

/-- The crest of the grade at `x`: a band across the carriageway with its reference point on the
    centre line. -/
def crestAt (x : Q) : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 20 .crest (Q.sub x (m 2)) (m (-10)) (Q.add x (m 2)) (m 10) with
      position := some (x, Q.zero) }

/-- Degrees of heading change swept since the onset at observation `k`: zero up to the onset,
    3 degrees per observation of the sweep, which lasts `turnSteps` observations. -/
def sweptAt (onset turnSteps k : Nat) : Nat :=
  if k ≤ onset then 0 else 3 * min (k - onset) turnSteps

/-- The rate of change of heading at observation `k`: straight running before the onset and after
    the sweep, a steady 60 deg/s to the left during it. -/
def yawAt (onset turnSteps k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k < onset then Q.zero
  else if k > onset + turnSteps then Q.zero
  else degPerSec 60

/-- The heading after `d` degrees of left-hand sweep from east, to the exact rational unit vectors
    the source records. -/
def headingOf (d : Nat) : Vec :=
  if d < 23 then Build.east
  else if d < 68 then (Units.ratio 4 5, Units.ratio 3 5)
  else if d < 113 then Build.north
  else if d < 158 then (Units.ratio (-3) 5, Units.ratio 4 5)
  else Build.west

/-- The subject at observation `k`: a body 5 m long and 2 m wide at `x0 + 0.4 k` metres along the
    carriageway, on the line `y`, running at 8 m/s with the heading and yaw rate of the sweep. -/
def subjectAt (classes : List RoadUserClass) (x0 y : Q) (onset turnSteps k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  Build.withKin
    (Build.user 1 classes (Q.add x0 (cm (40 * Int.ofNat k)), y)
      (headingOf (sweptAt onset turnSteps k)) (Units.metresPerSecond 8)
      (cm 250, m 1, cm 75) (some (cm (40 * Int.ofNat k))))
    (fun kin => { kin with yawRate := some (yawAt onset turnSteps k) })

/-- A trace of `n` observations at 50 ms over the structures `sts`, the subject running as above. -/
def runTrace (n : Nat) (sts : List Structure) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (x0 y : Q)
    (onset turnSteps : Nat) : Trace :=
  Build.trace n 0 step fun k t =>
    Build.scene t (some 1) [subjectAt classes x0 y onset turnSteps k] sts []

/-- The classes of the subject vehicle: a motor vehicle, a member of the aggregate the node claims. -/
def car : List RoadUserClass := [.motorVehicle]

/-- `forbid` (violated): The subject runs along a bend whose horizontal curvature stands well above the resolution, and the sight distance of its place falls short of the figure the text states. On that bend it swings through more than the reversal angle and proceeds back the way it came. -/
def forbidTrace : Trace :=
  runTrace 58 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 400) (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight]
    car (m 1) Q.zero 3 60

/-- `permit` (compliant): The same bend with the same short sight distance; the subject turns off into a side way, its accumulated heading change staying far below the reversal angle, and never proceeds in the opposite direction. No other road user is present in the scene. -/
def permitTrace : Trace :=
  runTrace 58 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 400) (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight]
    car (m 1) Q.zero 3 10

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): On a straight and level stretch, no crest region within the approach distance and the place's sight distance well beyond the stated figure, the subject swings through more than the reversal angle and proceeds back the way it came. -/
def idleTrace : Trace :=
  runTrace 58 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 400) tangent openSight]
    car (m 1) Q.zero 3 60

/-- `blind` (unknown): The subject reverses its direction on a bend whose curvature is recorded, but the source declares no sight distance for the places along it, so whether the vehicle could be seen within the stated distance cannot be told. -/
def blindTrace : Trace :=
  runTrace 58 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 400) (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight]
    car (m 1) Q.zero 3 60

/-- `occasion_s3` (violated): The subject begins the reversal on the bend and completes it where the alignment has run out straight: the curvature stands above the resolution at the onset and the first part of the manoeuvre only, and the sight distance at those same observations falls short of the stated figure. -/
def occasion_s3Trace : Trace :=
  runTrace 58 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 5) (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight,
    stretch 12 (m 5) (m 400) tangent shortSight] car (cm 110) Q.zero 3 60

/-- `occasion_s3_outside` (not_applicable): The subject runs along the bend, leaves it, and only then, on a straight stretch with no crest region within the approach distance, swings through more than the reversal angle; the curvature stands above the resolution only at observations before the onset, while the sight distance is short throughout. -/
def occasion_s3_outsideTrace : Trace :=

  1200 m by 60 m) with one or two roadway stretches on it (ids 11 and 12, each 20 m wide), and,
  where a witness needs one, a crest region (id 20, a 4 m band across the carriageway with its
  reference point on the centre line). A stretch carries the two figures the source records for it:
  the magnitude of its horizontal curvature (zero on a tangent, 1/50 m on a bend of 50 m radius,
  twenty times the resolution of the reading) and its sight distance (60 m, well short of the
  500 feet the text states, or 400 m, well beyond them).

  The subject (track 1) is a motor car 5 m long and 2 m wide running at 8 m/s, which is 0.4 m of
  carriageway per observation. Every trace is sampled at 50 ms, the period of the run's acquisition
  profile, so the heading change the rule accumulates is never read across a wider interval. The
  subject runs straight until the onset observation and from there its rate of change of heading
  stands at 60 deg/s to the left, 3 degrees per observation: 150 degrees — the reversal angle of the
  reading — are reached fifty observations after the onset. `permitTrace` holds that rate for ten
  observations only (30 degrees, far below the angle) and then runs straight again.

  The source of these witnesses reports the body's position, speed, path length, extent and rate of
  change of heading, and no heading vector: a heading that turned 3 degrees per observation is no
  rational direction, and a witness may not record one that disagrees with its own yaw rate. The
  rule reads no heading: the places are read by occupancy, which comes from the position, and the
  ground distance to the crest is then taken from the body's reference point, as
  `st.region_geometry` is read where no footprint is observed. The 20 m the body covers during a
  sweep is what carries it across a stretch boundary or away from the crest.

  manoeuvre, so each window begins at the onset observation and ends at the last observation of the
  trace. Every figure here is the witness's own and appears nowhere in the rule.

import TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B.NRS_484B_407
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_407

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n

-- Binders ↦ tracks: v ↦ 1

/-- The sampling period of the trace: one scene every 50 ms. -/
def step : Q := Units.milliseconds 50
/-- A rate of turn, in degrees per second. -/
def degPerSec (n : Int) : Q := Units.degrees n
/-- The horizontal curvature (1/m) of a bend of radius `r` metres. -/
def curvatureOfRadius (r : Int) : Q := Q.div (Units.perMetre 1) (m r)
/-- A tangent: the source records no curvature at all. -/
def tangent : Q := Q.zero
/-- The sight distance of a blind place, and of an open one. -/
def shortSight : Q := m 60
def openSight : Q := m 400

/-- The public way between its boundary lines: every subject below lies on it. -/
def way : Structure := Build.rect 10 .highway (m (-600)) (m (-30)) (m 600) (m 30)

/-- A carriageway stretch from `x0` to `x1`, with the curvature and sight distance the source
    records for it. -/
def stretch (id : RegionId) (x0 x1 curv sight : Q) : Structure :=
  { Build.rect id .roadway x0 (m (-10)) x1 (m 10) with
      curvature := some curv, sightDistance := some sight }

/-- The footway beside the carriageway, part of the way and no roadway. -/
def footway : Structure := Build.rect 13 .sidewalk (m (-200)) (m 15) (m 400) (m 25)

/-- The crest of the grade at `x`: a band across the carriageway with its reference point on the
    centre line. -/
def crestAt (x : Q) : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 20 .crest (Q.sub x (m 2)) (m (-10)) (Q.add x (m 2)) (m 10) with
      position := some (x, Q.zero) }

/-- The rate of change of heading at observation `k`: straight running before the onset and after
    the sweep, a steady 60 deg/s to the left during it. -/
def yawAt (onset turnSteps k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k < onset then Q.zero
  else if k > onset + turnSteps then Q.zero
  else degPerSec 60

/-- The subject at observation `k`: a body 5 m long and 2 m wide at `x0 + 0.4 k` metres along the
    carriageway, on the line `y`, running at 8 m/s with the yaw rate of the sweep and no heading
    vector recorded. -/
def subjectAt (classes : List RoadUserClass) (x0 y : Q) (onset turnSteps k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  Build.withKin
    (Build.user 1 classes (Q.add x0 (cm (40 * Int.ofNat k)), y)
      Build.east (Units.metresPerSecond 8) (cm 250, m 1, cm 75) (some (cm (40 * Int.ofNat k))))
    (fun kin => { kin with heading := none, velocity := none,
                           yawRate := some (yawAt onset turnSteps k) })

/-- A trace of `n` observations at 50 ms over the structures `sts`, the subject running as above. -/
def runTrace (n : Nat) (sts : List Structure) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (x0 y : Q)
    (onset turnSteps : Nat) : Trace :=
  Build.trace n 0 step fun k t =>
    Build.scene t (some 1) [subjectAt classes x0 y onset turnSteps k] sts []

/-- The classes of the subject vehicle: a motor vehicle, a member of the aggregate the node claims. -/

/-- `forbid` (violated): The subject runs along a bend whose horizontal curvature stands well above the resolution, and the sight distance of its place falls short of the figure the text states. On that bend it swings through more than the reversal angle and proceeds back the way it came. -/

    car (m 1) Q.zero 3 60

/-- `permit` (compliant): The same bend with the same short sight distance; the subject turns off into a side way, its accumulated heading change staying far below the reversal angle, and never proceeds in the opposite direction. No other road user is present in the scene. -/
def permitTrace : Trace :=
  runTrace 58 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 400) (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight]
    car (m 1) Q.zero 3 10

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): On a straight and level stretch, no crest region within the approach distance and the place's sight distance well beyond the stated figure, the subject swings through more than the reversal angle and proceeds back the way it came. -/
def idleTrace : Trace :=
  runTrace 58 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 400) tangent openSight]
    car (m 1) Q.zero 3 60

/-- `blind` (unknown): The subject reverses its direction on a bend whose curvature is recorded, but the source declares no sight distance for the places along it, so whether the vehicle could be seen within the stated distance cannot be told. -/
def blindTrace : Trace :=

    car (m 1) Q.zero 3 60

def occasion_s3Trace : Trace :=
  runTrace 58 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 5) (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight,
    stretch 12 (m 5) (m 400) tangent shortSight] car (cm 110) Q.zero 3 60

/-- `occasion_s3_outside` (not_applicable): The subject runs along the bend, leaves it, and only then, on a straight stretch with no crest region within the approach distance, swings through more than the reversal angle; the curvature stands above the resolution only at observations before the onset, while the sight distance is short throughout. -/
def occasion_s3_outsideTrace : Trace :=
  runTrace 75 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 5) (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight,
    stretch 12 (m 5) (m 400) tangent shortSight] car (cm 110) Q.zero 20 60

/-- `occasion_s4` (violated): The subject begins the reversal with the crest region within the approach distance of its body and completes it farther down the grade, beyond that distance; the alignment is straight throughout and the sight distance at the observations near the crest falls short of the stated figure. -/
def occasion_s4Trace : Trace :=
  runTrace 58 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 400) tangent shortSight, crestAt Q.zero]
    car (m 143) Q.zero 3 60

/-- `occasion_s4_outside` (not_applicable): The subject passes the crest, runs on until the crest region lies beyond the approach distance, and only then swings through more than the reversal angle on a straight stretch; the crest was within the approach distance only at observations before the onset, while the sight distance is short throughout. -/
def occasion_s4_outsideTrace : Trace :=
  runTrace 95 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 400) tangent shortSight, crestAt Q.zero]
    car (m 145) Q.zero 40 60

/-- `occasion_s5` (violated): The subject reverses its direction on a bend whose curvature stands above the resolution at every observation of the manoeuvre, and the sight distance of its place falls short of the stated figure at the onset and the first part of the manoeuvre, rising above it before the reversal is complete. -/
def occasion_s5Trace : Trace :=
  runTrace 58 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 5) (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight,
    stretch 12 (m 5) (m 400) (curvatureOfRadius 50) openSight] car (cm 110) Q.zero 3 60

/-- `occasion_s5_outside` (not_applicable): The subject runs on the bend through a stretch whose sight distance falls short of the stated figure, and begins and completes the reversal farther along the same bend, where the sight distance at its place exceeds the stated figure at every observation from the onset onwards. -/
def occasion_s5_outsideTrace : Trace :=
  runTrace 75 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 5) (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight,
    stretch 12 (m 5) (m 400) (curvatureOfRadius 50) openSight] car (cm 110) Q.zero 20 60

/-- `branch_1` (not_applicable): a pedal cycle, no member of the aggregate the duty binds, reverses
    its direction on the blind bend of `forbid`. -/
def branch_1Trace : Trace :=
  runTrace 58 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 400) (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight]
    [.bicycle] (m 1) Q.zero 3 60

/-- `branch_2` (not_applicable): the subject turns around on the footway beside the blind bend,
    occupying the way and no roadway. -/
def branch_2Trace : Trace :=
  runTrace 58 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 400) (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight, footway]
    car (m 1) (m 20) 3 60

/-- `branch_3` (not_applicable): a straight stretch whose sight distance is short, with a crest
    region 400 m behind the subject — far beyond the approach distance. -/
def branch_3Trace : Trace :=
  runTrace 58 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 600) tangent shortSight, crestAt Q.zero]
    car (m 405) Q.zero 3 60

def witness (name : String) (τ : Trace) (expected : Verdict) (from_ to_ : Timestamp)
    (absent : List String := []) (boundary : String := "") : Scenario :=

    rule := "NRS_484B_407"
    trace := τ
    reading := {}          -- ignored by the gate: the run's reading is substituted
    manifest := Build.manifest absent
    grounding := [("v", 1)]
    expected := expected
    window := some (from_, to_)
    boundary := boundary }

def scenarios : List Scenario :=
  [ witness "forbid" forbidTrace .violated 150 2850
  , witness "permit" permitTrace .compliant 150 2850
  , witness "idle" idleTrace .notApplicable 150 2850
  , witness "blind" blindTrace (.unknown []) 150 2850 ["st.sight_distance"]
  , witness "occasion_s3" occasion_s3Trace .violated 150 2850
  , witness "occasion_s3_outside" occasion_s3_outsideTrace .notApplicable 1000 3700
  , witness "occasion_s4" occasion_s4Trace .violated 150 2850
  , witness "occasion_s4_outside" occasion_s4_outsideTrace .notApplicable 2000 4700
  , witness "occasion_s5" occasion_s5Trace .violated 150 2850
  , witness "occasion_s5_outside" occasion_s5_outsideTrace .notApplicable 1000 3700
  , witness "branch_1" branch_1Trace .notApplicable 150 2850
  , witness "branch_2" branch_2Trace .notApplicable 150 2850
  , witness "branch_3" branch_3Trace .notApplicable 150 2850 ]

end TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_407

/-- Degrees of heading change swept since the onset at observation `k`: zero up to the onset,
    3 degrees per observation of the sweep, which lasts `turnSteps` observations. -/
def sweptAt (onset turnSteps k : Nat) : Nat :=
  if k ≤ onset then 0 else 3 * min (k - onset) turnSteps

/-- The rate of change of heading at observation `k`: straight running before the onset and after
    the sweep, a steady 60 deg/s to the left during it. -/
def yawAt (onset turnSteps k : Nat) : Q :=
  if k < onset then Q.zero
  else if k > onset + turnSteps then Q.zero
  else degPerSec 60

/-- The heading after `d` degrees of left-hand sweep from east, to the exact rational unit vectors
    the source records. -/
def headingOf (d : Nat) : Vec :=
  if d < 23 then Build.east
  else if d < 68 then (Units.ratio 4 5, Units.ratio 3 5)
  else if d < 113 then Build.north
  else if d < 158 then (Units.ratio (-3) 5, Units.ratio 4 5)
  else Build.west

/-- The subject at observation `k`: a body 5 m long and 2 m wide at `x0 + 0.4 k` metres along the
    carriageway, on the line `y`, running at 8 m/s with the heading and yaw rate of the sweep. -/
def subjectAt (classes : List RoadUserClass) (x0 y : Q) (onset turnSteps k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  Build.withKin
    (Build.user 1 classes (Q.add x0 (cm (40 * Int.ofNat k)), y)
      (headingOf (sweptAt onset turnSteps k)) (Units.metresPerSecond 8)
      (cm 250, m 1, cm 75) (some (cm (40 * Int.ofNat k))))
    (fun kin => { kin with yawRate := some (yawAt onset turnSteps k) })

/-- A trace of `n` observations at 50 ms over the structures `sts`, the subject running as above. -/
def runTrace (n : Nat) (sts : List Structure) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (x0 y : Q)
    (onset turnSteps : Nat) : Trace :=
  Build.trace n 0 step fun k t =>
    Build.scene t (some 1) [subjectAt classes x0 y onset turnSteps k] sts []

/-- The classes of the subject vehicle: a motor vehicle, a member of the aggregate the node claims. -/
def car : List RoadUserClass := [.motorVehicle]

/-- `forbid` (violated): The subject runs along a bend whose horizontal curvature stands well above the resolution, and the sight distance of its place falls short of the figure the text states. On that bend it swings through more than the reversal angle and proceeds back the way it came. -/
def forbidTrace : Trace :=
  runTrace 58 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 400) (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight]
    car (m 1) Q.zero 3 60

/-- `permit` (compliant): The same bend with the same short sight distance; the subject turns off into a side way, its accumulated heading change staying far below the reversal angle, and never proceeds in the opposite direction. No other road user is present in the scene. -/
def permitTrace : Trace :=
  runTrace 58 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 400) (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight]
    car (m 1) Q.zero 3 10

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): On a straight and level stretch, no crest region within the approach distance and the place's sight distance well beyond the stated figure, the subject swings through more than the reversal angle and proceeds back the way it came. -/
def idleTrace : Trace :=
  runTrace 58 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 400) tangent openSight]
    car (m 1) Q.zero 3 60

/-- `blind` (unknown): The subject reverses its direction on a bend whose curvature is recorded, but the source declares no sight distance for the places along it, so whether the vehicle could be seen within the stated distance cannot be told. -/
def blindTrace : Trace :=
  runTrace 58 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 400) (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight]
    car (m 1) Q.zero 3 60

/-- `occasion_s3` (violated): The subject begins the reversal on the bend and completes it where the alignment has run out straight: the curvature stands above the resolution at the onset and the first part of the manoeuvre only, and the sight distance at those same observations falls short of the stated figure. -/
def occasion_s3Trace : Trace :=
  runTrace 58 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 5) (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight,
    stretch 12 (m 5) (m 400) tangent shortSight] car (cm 110) Q.zero 3 60

/-- `occasion_s3_outside` (not_applicable): The subject runs along the bend, leaves it, and only then, on a straight stretch with no crest region within the approach distance, swings through more than the reversal angle; the curvature stands above the resolution only at observations before the onset, while the sight distance is short throughout. -/
def occasion_s3_outsideTrace : Trace :=
  runTrace 75 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 5) (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight,
    stretch 12 (m 5) (m 400) tangent shortSight] car (cm 110) Q.zero 20 60

/-- `occasion_s4` (violated): The subject begins the reversal with the crest region within the approach distance of its body and completes it farther down the grade, beyond that distance; the alignment is straight throughout and the sight distance at the observations near the crest falls short of the stated figure. -/
def occasion_s4Trace : Trace :=
  runTrace 58 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 400) tangent shortSight, crestAt Q.zero]
    car (m 146) Q.zero 3 60

/-- `occasion_s4_outside` (not_applicable): The subject passes the crest, runs on until the crest region lies beyond the approach distance, and only then swings through more than the reversal angle on a straight stretch; the crest was within the approach distance only at observations before the onset, while the sight distance is short throughout. -/
def occasion_s4_outsideTrace : Trace :=
  runTrace 85 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 400) tangent shortSight, crestAt Q.zero]
    car (cm 14950) Q.zero 30 60

/-- `occasion_s5` (violated): The subject reverses its direction on a bend whose curvature stands above the resolution at every observation of the manoeuvre, and the sight distance of its place falls short of the stated figure at the onset and the first part of the manoeuvre, rising above it before the reversal is complete. -/
def occasion_s5Trace : Trace :=
  runTrace 58 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 5) (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight,
    stretch 12 (m 5) (m 400) (curvatureOfRadius 50) openSight] car (cm 110) Q.zero 3 60

/-- `occasion_s5_outside` (not_applicable): The subject runs on the bend through a stretch whose sight distance falls short of the stated figure, and begins and completes the reversal farther along the same bend, where the sight distance at its place exceeds the stated figure at every observation from the onset onwards. -/
def occasion_s5_outsideTrace : Trace :=
  runTrace 75 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 5) (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight,
    stretch 12 (m 5) (m 400) (curvatureOfRadius 50) openSight] car (cm 110) Q.zero 20 60

/-- `branch_1` (not_applicable): a pedal cycle, no member of the aggregate the duty binds, reverses
    its direction on the blind bend of `forbid`. -/
def branch_1Trace : Trace :=
  runTrace 58 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 400) (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight]
    [.bicycle] (m 1) Q.zero 3 60

/-- `branch_2` (not_applicable): the subject turns around on the footway beside the blind bend,
    occupying the way but no roadway. -/
def branch_2Trace : Trace :=
  runTrace 58 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 400) (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight, footway]
    car (m 1) (m 20) 3 60

/-- `branch_3` (not_applicable): a straight stretch whose sight distance is short, with a crest
    region 400 m behind the subject — far beyond the approach distance. -/
def branch_3Trace : Trace :=
  runTrace 58 [way, stretch 11 (m (-200)) (m 600) tangent shortSight, crestAt Q.zero]
    car (m 405) Q.zero 3 60

def witness (name : String) (τ : Trace) (expected : Verdict) (from_ to_ : Timestamp)
    (absent : List String := []) (boundary : String := "") : Scenario :=
  { name := name
    rule := "NRS_484B_407"
    trace := τ
    reading := {}          -- ignored by the gate: the run's reading is substituted
    manifest := Build.manifest absent
    grounding := [("v", 1)]
    expected := expected
    window := some (from_, to_)
    boundary := boundary }

def scenarios : List Scenario :=
  [ witness "forbid" forbidTrace .violated 150 2850
  , witness "permit" permitTrace .compliant 150 2850
  , witness "idle" idleTrace .notApplicable 150 2850
  , witness "blind" blindTrace (.unknown []) 150 2850 ["st.sight_distance"]
  , witness "occasion_s3" occasion_s3Trace .violated 150 2850
  , witness "occasion_s3_outside" occasion_s3_outsideTrace .notApplicable 1000 3700
  , witness "occasion_s4" occasion_s4Trace .violated 150 2850
  , witness "occasion_s4_outside" occasion_s4_outsideTrace .notApplicable 1500 4200
  , witness "occasion_s5" occasion_s5Trace .violated 150 2850
  , witness "occasion_s5_outside" occasion_s5_outsideTrace .notApplicable 1000 3700
  , witness "branch_1" branch_1Trace .notApplicable 150 2850
  , witness "branch_2" branch_2Trace .notApplicable 150 2850
  , witness "branch_3" branch_3Trace .notApplicable 150 2850 ]

end TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_407

/-
  Witnesses for NRS_484B_407.

  The geometry, once built. A highway region (`way`, id 10, 1200 m by 60 m) carries one or two
  roadway regions (ids 11 and 12) and, where a witness needs one, a crest region (id 20: a 4 m band
  across the carriageway, with its reference point on the centre line and its boundary polygon).
  Each roadway carries the two figures the source records for it: the magnitude of its horizontal
  curvature (zero on a tangent, 1/50 m on a bend of 50 m radius, twenty times the resolution of the
  reading) and its sight distance (60 m, well short of the 500 feet the text states, or 400 m, well
  beyond them). Where a witness needs the subject to leave one roadway for another, the two are
  either the halves of a divided highway, 2 m of median apart (`occasion_s3`, `occasion_s5`: the
  sweep carries the body from the one to the other), or two stretches of one carriageway meeting at
  x = 5 m, which the straight run before the onset crosses (`occasion_s3_outside`,
  `occasion_s5_outside`).

  The subject (track 1) is a motor car 5 m long and 2 m wide running at 4 m/s, which is 0.2 m of
  path per observation. Every trace is sampled at 50 ms, the period of the run's acquisition
  profile, so the heading change the rule accumulates is never read across a wider interval. The
  body runs straight east until the onset observation; from there its heading turns by one rotation
  step per observation — cos 840/841, sin 41/841, which is 2.794362050 degrees, the exact rational
  rotation that a recorded yaw rate of 55.887241 deg/s turns over 50 ms — and its place advances
  0.2 m along the heading each interval, so the path is the arc of that rate: a turning radius of
  about 4.1 m and a reversal of 150 degrees, the angle of the reading, fifty-four observations after
  the onset. `permitTrace` holds that rate for ten observations only (28 degrees, far below the
  angle) and then runs straight again. A heading component is recorded to the nanometre, so the
  recorded direction does not grow without bound as the rotation is iterated; the figures the rule
  reads are decided by metres.

  A sweep of 150 degrees carries a body about twice its turning radius, some 4 m here, so no
  witness can show a crest leaving the approach distance of 150 m within the manoeuvre itself: in
  `occasion_s4` the crest region stands within that distance at the onset and at every later
  observation of the act (by 11 m or more), and it is `occasion_s4_outside` that shows the span held
  outside the act — there the straight run before the onset carries the body from 5 m within the
  approach distance to 5 m beyond it, and the act begins only then.

  Every witness names the instants it speaks about: the rule searches the past from the onset of the
  manoeuvre, so each window begins at the onset observation and ends at the last observation of the
  trace. Every figure here is the witness's own and appears nowhere in the rule.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B.NRS_484B_407
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_407

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n

-- Binders ↦ tracks: v ↦ 1

/-- The sampling period of the trace: one scene every 50 ms. -/
def step : Q := Units.milliseconds 50
/-- The subject's speed, and the path it covers in one interval at that speed. -/
def speed : Q := Units.metresPerSecond 4
def advance : Q := cm 20

/-- The exact rational rotation of one observation: cos 840/841, sin 41/841 (840² + 41² = 841²). -/
def cosStep : Q := Units.ratio 840 841
def sinStep : Q := Units.ratio 41 841
/-- That rotation's angle, 2.794362050 degrees, written as a count of nanodegrees since `Units`
    carries no angle finer than the degree. -/
def stepAngle : Q := Q.div (Units.degrees 2794362050) (Q.ofInt 1000000000)
/-- The rate of change of heading the source records during the sweep: one rotation step per
    interval, 55.887241 deg/s. -/
def sweepYawRate : Q := Q.div stepAngle step

/-- A heading component as the source records it, to the nanometre. -/
def grid (q : Q) : Q := Q.mk' ((q.num * 1000000000) / Int.ofNat q.den) 1000000000

/-- The heading after one rotation step. -/
def rotateStep (h : Vec) : Vec :=
  (grid (Q.sub (Q.mul cosStep h.1) (Q.mul sinStep h.2)),
   grid (Q.add (Q.mul sinStep h.1) (Q.mul cosStep h.2)))

/-- The heading at the observation after `k`: one rotation step where the sweep covers the interval
    that ends there, the heading it had otherwise. -/
def headingNext (onset turnSteps k : Nat) (h : Vec) : Vec :=
  if onset ≤ k + 1 ∧ k + 1 ≤ onset + turnSteps then rotateStep h else h

/-- The place after one interval of running along the heading recorded at its end. -/
def nextPlace (p h : Vec) : Vec := (Q.add p.1 (Q.mul advance h.1), Q.add p.2 (Q.mul advance h.2))

/-- The rate of change of heading at observation `k`: zero before the onset and after the sweep,
    one rotation step over the interval that ends there during it. -/
def yawAt (onset turnSteps k : Nat) : Q :=
  if onset ≤ k ∧ k ≤ onset + turnSteps then sweepYawRate else Q.zero

/-- The body's place and heading at each observation of a run, accumulated once. -/
def bodyStates (onset turnSteps : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Vec → Vec → List (Vec × Vec)
  | 0, _, _, _ => []
  | i + 1, k, p, h =>
    let h' := headingNext onset turnSteps k h
    (p, h) :: bodyStates onset turnSteps i (k + 1) (nextPlace p h') h'

/-- The subject at observation `k`, with the place, heading, speed, path length, extent and rate of
    change of heading the source records. -/
def bodyAt (classes : List RoadUserClass) (p h : Vec) (onset turnSteps k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  Build.withKin
    (Build.user 1 classes p h speed (cm 250, m 1, cm 75) (some (cm (20 * Int.ofNat k))))
    (fun kin => { kin with yawRate := some (yawAt onset turnSteps k) })

/-- The public way between its boundary lines: every subject below lies on it. -/
def way : Structure := Build.rect 10 .highway (m (-600)) (m (-30)) (m 600) (m 30)

/-- A roadway region with the curvature and sight distance the source records for it. -/
def carriageway (id : RegionId) (x0 y0 x1 y1 curv sight : Q) : Structure :=
  { Build.rect id .roadway x0 y0 x1 y1 with
      curvature := some curv, sightDistance := some sight }

/-- The footway beside the carriageway: part of the way and no roadway. -/
def footway : Structure := Build.rect 13 .sidewalk (m (-200)) (m 15) (m 400) (m 25)

/-- The crest of the grade at `x`: a band across the carriageway, with its reference point on the
    centre line. -/
def crestAt (x : Q) : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 20 .crest (Q.sub x (m 2)) (m (-10)) (Q.add x (m 2)) (m 10) with
      position := some (x, Q.zero) }

/-- The horizontal curvature (1/m) of a bend of radius `r` metres. -/
def curvatureOfRadius (r : Int) : Q := Q.div (Units.perMetre 1) (m r)
/-- A tangent: the alignment the source records as straight. -/
def tangent : Q := Q.zero
/-- The sight distance of a blind place, and of an open one. -/
def shortSight : Q := m 60
def openSight : Q := m 400

/-- The classes of the subject vehicle: a motor vehicle, a member of the aggregate the node claims. -/
def car : List RoadUserClass := [.motorVehicle]

/-- A run of `n` observations at 50 ms over the structures `sts`. -/
def runTrace (n : Nat) (sts : List Structure) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (x0 y0 : Q)

def grid (q : Q) : Q := Q.mk' ((q.num * 1000000000) / Int.ofNat q.den) 1000000000

/-- The heading after one rotation step. -/
def rotateStep (h : Vec) : Vec :=
  (grid (Q.sub (Q.mul cosStep h.1) (Q.mul sinStep h.2)),
   grid (Q.add (Q.mul sinStep h.1) (Q.mul cosStep h.2)))

/-- The heading at the observation after `k`: one rotation step where the sweep covers the interval
    that ends there, the heading it had otherwise. -/
def headingNext (onset turnSteps k : Nat) (h : Vec) : Vec :=
  if onset ≤ k + 1 ∧ k + 1 ≤ onset + turnSteps then rotateStep h else h

/-- The place after one interval of running along the heading recorded at its end. -/
def nextPlace (p h : Vec) : Vec := (Q.add p.1 (Q.mul advance h.1), Q.add p.2 (Q.mul advance h.2))

/-- The rate of change of heading at observation `k`: zero before the onset and after the sweep,
    one rotation step over the interval that ends there during it. -/
def yawAt (onset turnSteps k : Nat) : Q :=
  if onset ≤ k ∧ k ≤ onset + turnSteps then sweepYawRate else Q.zero

/-- The body's place and heading at each observation of a run, accumulated once. -/
def bodyStates (onset turnSteps : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Vec → Vec → List (Vec × Vec)
  | 0, _, _, _ => []
  | i + 1, k, p, h =>
    let h' := headingNext onset turnSteps k h
    (p, h) :: bodyStates onset turnSteps i (k + 1) (nextPlace p h') h'

/-- The subject at observation `k`, with the place, heading, speed, path length, extent and rate of
    change of heading the source records. -/
def bodyAt (classes : List RoadUserClass) (p h : Vec) (onset turnSteps k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  Build.withKin
    (Build.user 1 classes p h speed (cm 250, m 1, cm 75) (some (cm (20 * Int.ofNat k))))
    (fun kin => { kin with yawRate := some (yawAt onset turnSteps k) })

/-- The public way between its boundary lines: every subject below lies on it. -/
def way : Structure := Build.rect 10 .highway (m (-600)) (m (-30)) (m 600) (m 30)

/-- A roadway region with the curvature and sight distance the source records for it. -/
def carriageway (id : RegionId) (x0 y0 x1 y1 curv sight : Q) : Structure :=
  { Build.rect id .roadway x0 y0 x1 y1 with
      curvature := some curv, sightDistance := some sight }

/-- The footway beside the carriageway: part of the way and no roadway. -/
def footway : Structure := Build.rect 13 .sidewalk (m (-200)) (m 15) (m 400) (m 25)

/-- The crest of the grade at `x`: a band across the carriageway, with its reference point on the
    centre line. -/
def crestAt (x : Q) : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 20 .crest (Q.sub x (m 2)) (m (-10)) (Q.add x (m 2)) (m 10) with
      position := some (x, Q.zero) }

/-- The horizontal curvature (1/m) of a bend of radius `r` metres. -/
def curvatureOfRadius (r : Int) : Q := Q.div (Units.perMetre 1) (m r)
/-- A tangent: the alignment the source records as straight. -/
def tangent : Q := Q.zero
/-- The sight distance of a blind place, and of an open one. -/
def shortSight : Q := m 60
def openSight : Q := m 400

/-- The classes of the subject vehicle: a motor vehicle, a member of the aggregate the node claims. -/
def car : List RoadUserClass := [.motorVehicle]

/-- A run of `n` observations at 50 ms over the structures `sts`. -/
def runTrace (n : Nat) (sts : List Structure) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (x0 y0 : Q)
    (onset turnSteps : Nat) : Trace :=
  let states := bodyStates onset turnSteps n 0 (x0, y0) Build.east
  Build.trace n 0 step fun k t =>
    let pb := states.getD k ((x0, y0), Build.east)
    Build.scene t (some 1) [bodyAt classes pb.1 pb.2 onset turnSteps k] sts []

/-- One carriageway 20 m wide, from x = −200 m to x = 400 m. -/
def oneWay (curv sight : Q) : Structure := carriageway 11 (m (-200)) (m (-10)) (m 400) (m 10) curv sight

/-- `forbid` (violated): The subject runs along a bend whose horizontal curvature stands well above the resolution, and the sight distance of its place falls short of the figure the text states. On that bend it swings through more than the reversal angle and proceeds back the way it came. -/
def forbidTrace : Trace :=
  runTrace 61 [way, oneWay (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight] car (m 1) Q.zero 3 60

/-- `permit` (compliant): The same bend with the same short sight distance; the subject turns off into a side way, its accumulated heading change staying far below the reversal angle, and never proceeds in the opposite direction. No other road user is present in the scene. -/
def permitTrace : Trace :=
  runTrace 61 [way, oneWay (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight] car (m 1) Q.zero 3 10

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): On a straight and level stretch, no crest region within the approach distance and the place's sight distance well beyond the stated figure, the subject swings through more than the reversal angle and proceeds back the way it came. -/
def idleTrace : Trace :=
  runTrace 61 [way, oneWay tangent openSight] car (m 1) Q.zero 3 60

/-- `blind` (unknown): The subject reverses its direction on a bend whose curvature is recorded, but the source declares no sight distance for the places along it, so whether the vehicle could be seen within the stated distance cannot be told. -/
def blindTrace : Trace :=
  runTrace 61 [way, oneWay (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight] car (m 1) Q.zero 3 60

/-- `occasion_s3` (violated): The subject begins the reversal on the bend and completes it where the alignment has run out straight: the curvature stands above the resolution at the onset and the first part of the manoeuvre only, and the sight distance at those same observations falls short of the stated figure. -/
def occasion_s3Trace : Trace :=
  runTrace 61 [way,
    carriageway 11 (m (-200)) (m (-10)) (m 400) Q.zero (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight,
    carriageway 12 (m (-200)) (m 2) (m 400) (m 12) tangent shortSight]
    car (m 1) (m (-1)) 3 60

/-- `occasion_s3_outside` (not_applicable): The subject runs along the bend, leaves it, and only then, on a straight stretch with no crest region within the approach distance, swings through more than the reversal angle; the curvature stands above the resolution only at observations before the onset, while the sight distance is short throughout. -/
def occasion_s3_outsideTrace : Trace :=

    carriageway 11 (m (-200)) (m (-10)) (m 5) (m 10) (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight,
    carriageway 12 (m 5) (m (-10)) (m 400) (m 10) tangent shortSight]
    car (cm 110) Q.zero 40 60

/-- `occasion_s4` (violated): The subject begins the reversal with the crest region within the approach distance of its body and completes it farther down the grade, beyond that distance; the alignment is straight throughout and the sight distance at the observations near the crest falls short of the stated figure. -/
def occasion_s4Trace : Trace :=
  runTrace 61 [way, oneWay tangent shortSight, crestAt Q.zero] car (m 142) Q.zero 3 60

/-- `occasion_s4_outside` (not_applicable): The subject passes the crest, runs on until the crest region lies beyond the approach distance, and only then swings through more than the reversal angle on a straight stretch; the crest was within the approach distance only at observations before the onset, while the sight distance is short throughout. -/
def occasion_s4_outsideTrace : Trace :=
  runTrace 113 [way, oneWay tangent shortSight, crestAt Q.zero] car (m 149) Q.zero 55 60

/-- `occasion_s5` (violated): The subject reverses its direction on a bend whose curvature stands above the resolution at every observation of the manoeuvre, and the sight distance of its place falls short of the stated figure at the onset and the first part of the manoeuvre, rising above it before the reversal is complete. -/
def occasion_s5Trace : Trace :=
  runTrace 61 [way,
    carriageway 11 (m (-200)) (m (-10)) (m 400) Q.zero (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight,
    carriageway 12 (m (-200)) (m 2) (m 400) (m 12) (curvatureOfRadius 50) openSight]
    car (m 1) (m (-1)) 3 60

/-- `occasion_s5_outside` (not_applicable): The subject runs on the bend through a stretch whose sight distance falls short of the stated figure, and begins and completes the reversal farther along the same bend, where the sight distance at its place exceeds the stated figure at every observation from the onset onwards. -/

  runTrace 98 [way,
    carriageway 11 (m (-200)) (m (-10)) (m 5) (m 10) (curvatureOfRadius 50) shortSight,
    carriageway 12 (m 5) (m (-10)) (m 400) (m 10) (curvatureOfRadius 50) openSight]
    car (cm 110) Q.zero 40 60

  , witness "occasion_s4" occasion_s4Trace .violated 150 3000

  , witness "occasion_s5" occasion_s5Trace .violated 150 3000

def way : Structure := Build.rect 10 .highway (m (-600)) (m (-30)) (m 600) (m 30)

    records for it. -/

/-- The footway beside the carriageway, part of the way and no roadway. -/
def footway : Structure := Build.rect 13 .sidewalk (m (-200)) (m 15) (m 400) (m 25)

    centre line. -/
def crestAt (x : Q) : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 20 .crest (Q.sub x (m 2)) (m (-10)) (Q.add x (m 2)) (m 10) with
      position := some (x, Q.zero) }

    the sweep, a steady 60 deg/s to the left during it. -/

  if k < onset then Q.zero

    carriageway, on the line `y`, running at 8 m/s with the yaw rate of the sweep and no heading
    vector recorded. -/

**Final verdict: `OK`** (`13 witnesses, 10 names, composes nothing`), on gate run 3 of a budget of 6.

- `library/TrafficSpec/Rules/NRS_484B/NRS_484B_407.lean` — `clsV`, `applicability`, `obligation`
  and the named sub-formulas they are built from; declarations the node fixes (`laws`, `binders`,

  wrote them. `narrowings := []`.
- `library/TrafficSpecWitness/NRS_484B/NRS_484B_407.lean` — the ten planned scenarios plus three
  `branch_*` scenarios, all built from `Build.*`.

## The rule, span by span

- **s1** — `ru_aggregate` of the binder with the claimed aggregate id as its literal argument.
- **s2** — the one call the element names, `drv_motion_u_turn`, with the three parameters of its
  signature in order (heading step, onset yaw rate, reversal angle). The record declares
  `boundary: "event"` and a recognition "where the concept rises", so the obligation is
  `.not (.rises uTurnReversal)`: the duty is broken at the recognition observation and at no later
  observation of the same manoeuvre.
- **s3 / s4 / s5** — one region quantifier over `roadway` per element, each anchored to the binder
  by `rel_occupies` and naming `st_roadway` as the record maps it; then the curvature at or above
  `p.curvature_resolution` (s3), a `crest` region whose ground distance from the body
  (`st_region_geometry_distance`) is at most `p.crest_approach_distance` (s4), and the place's
  `st_sight_distance` below the text's own 500 feet (s5). "or" joins s3 and s4; "where" joins s5 to
  them: `conditions = (s3 ∨ s4) ∧ s5`, so one and the same observation carries the place and the
  sight.
- **the occasion** — `onset` is the record's onset element (`.rises` of
  `|kin_yaw_rate| > p.turn_onset_yaw_rate`), `underWay` its under-way element in its own terms
  (that magnitude above the onset rate, and the heading change accumulated since the onset still
  below the reversal angle, with the reviewed step bound of the acquisition profile). The
  applicability is `.since (.not onset) (underWay ∧ conditions)`: the conditions held together at
  some observation of the stretch from the observed onset of this manoeuvre to the observation being
  judged. `.not onset` as the left operand of `since` ends the search exactly at that onset, which
  is what makes the four `occasion_*_outside` witnesses not applicable.

1. **One quantifier per condition span, not one shared region.** Each of s3, s4, s5 claims its own
   `rel.occupies` and `st.roadway`, so each is written with its own `roadway` quantifier. A single
   shared region variable would have been narrower than the words (it would require one roadway to
   carry the curvature, the crest and the sight distance), and these are condition spans, which are
   never narrowed. No narrowing is declared.
2. **The crest distance is the body-to-region distance of `st.region_geometry`.** The record's s4
   justification names exactly this reading, so it is the plan's and is not restated as a narrowing.
3. **`.since (.not onset) …` for `some_moment` over an event act.** The record gives the onset
   element and the recognition point but no window parameter; `since` with the onset as its right
   operand is the only operator that bounds the search at the declared onset of the occurrence being
   judged. Before any observed onset the rule is unknown (the recording cannot say whether a
   manoeuvre was already under way), which is why every witness names its window from the onset
   observation on — the plan declares no history boundary, and no witness is unknown for a
   truncation.

   152.4 m, crest distances of about 138 m and 155 m against the 150 m of the reading.

   by about twice its turning radius — some 4 m here — so no physically consistent trace can show a
   crest passing out of a 150 m approach distance *within* the manoeuvre. In `occasion_s4` the crest
   stands within the approach distance at the onset and at every later observation of the act (by
   11 m or more), which is what makes the witness violated through the s4 limb;
